summary: Raise the published CLI Go toolchain floor to 1.26.6 so reachable standard-library vulnerability fixes are enforced by go install.
reason: Go 1.26.6 carries standard-library fixes reported by govulncheck against the Notion CLI's reachable net/http, crypto/tls, net/url, and encoding/asn1 call paths.
validated_outcome: govulncheck ./... no longer reports reachable standard-library vulnerabilities for the Notion CLI.
